publication_policy: Open product questions do not block Profile Preview unless public facts are misstated; they block only the affected verified claim or future extension.

items.safe_preview_rule: Preserve the official product value as a decimal string and never convert units implicitly.

items.topic: Payment-Proof Base64 versus Base64URL product acceptance
items.safe_preview_rule: Follow the current official Alipay product documentation in the Profile; do not project ACT Core encoding onto the product wire format.
Forward client_session when supplied by the official workflow and never synthesize it.

items.topic: app_auth_token and seller_app_id for third-party calls
items.safe_preview_rule: Keep third-party application mode outside the self-developed Quickstart claim.
Use atomic replay occupation and retain through the declared proof/fulfillment evidence deadline; production persistence remains implementer-owned.
Keep payment, delivery and fulfillment outcomes separate and never repeat payment or non-idempotent delivery during confirmation retry.
The current Profile covers only the public Skill/CLI route.

items.topic: native seller MCP or Skill payment binding
items.safe_preview_rule: The current seller transport baseline remains HTTP 402; resource type does not imply a new payment protocol.
